summary: Backend-only iteration 15 verification completed against the public preview URL. All 4 targeted fix tests passed: six truly concurrent aiohttp invite accepts produced exactly one 200 and five 410 responses with no 400 and one persisted user; spoofed image bytes and GIF/BMP were rejected while real PIL PNG/JPEG uploads succeeded; owner-scoped invite detail returned the complete contract while non-owner and malformed IDs returned 404; seven concurrent wrong-password logins preserved every 401 increment in one counter document, reached lockout, and the next correct-password attempt returned 429. All 16 applicable iteration 14 regressions and all 15 iteration 13 billing tests also passed (35/35 total).
critical_code_review_comments: The four scoped implementations match the required behavior. Invite claiming uses a conditional used_at transition on a uniquely indexed token; firm-logo bytes are base64-decoded and PIL-verified; invite detail catches malformed ObjectIds; login failures use Mongo $inc and conditional lock timestamp creation.

Non-blocking hardening note: login_attempts.identifier is indexed but not unique. The executed seven-request API race and an additional 100-way direct upsert probe both produced exactly one document with no lost count, but making this index unique would database-enforce the intended one-counter-per-email invariant.

Non-blocking hardening note: invite claim is atomic for concurrent callers, but user creation, default document-type inserts, and accepted_user_id update are not a Mongo transaction; an unexpected database failure after user insertion could leave partial post-claim state. No such failure occurred in testing.

success_rate.backend: 100% (35/35 executed tests passed: targeted fixes 4/4, applicable iteration 14 regressions 16/16, billing regressions 15/15)

seed_data_creation: Created fresh invite targets, a foreign invite owner, a fresh lockout account, expired-trial/billing regression accounts, journal/intake resources, temporary firm-logo/seal data, and two Stripe test Checkout Sessions. Mongo users/resources/invites/login counters/brand changes/payment rows and Stripe customers were cleaned up; immutable Stripe sandbox Checkout Session history remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use test_iteration15.py for the required asyncio.gather/aiohttp concurrency checks. The invite race uses six simultaneous POSTs and verifies one user plus accepted_user_id. The lockout race uses seven simultaneous wrong-password POSTs, verifies one login_attempts document, count equals the number of 401 responses and is at least five, then confirms a correct password is blocked with 429 before cleanup. Iteration 14 CORS wildcard and GET /api/invites wrapper assertions were intentionally excluded per the review note; wrapper-based invite listing and owner isolation were still verified in iteration 15.
rca_of_the_issue: The iteration 14 defects are resolved by a conditional Mongo invite claim before user creation, decoded-byte/PIL format validation for logos, a new owner-filtered invite-detail route with controlled ObjectId handling, and atomic Mongo $inc for login counters with conditional locked_until creation. Public endpoint tests confirmed each fix and no scoped regression.
